title: PaymentPayload
description: Payload of every payment.events message (PAYMENT_INITIATED, PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED, PAYMENT_FAILED, PAYMENT_REFUNDED), inside the usual envelope; the envelope's rideId is the ride the payment is for (and the Kafka key). Mirrors com.rydex.events.PaymentPayload. PAYMENT_INITIATED means the rider must pay in Razorpay Checkout; the mock provider never sends it. Consumers must ignore unknown fields.

kind.description: A completed ride's fare, or the fee for cancelling after the driver arrived.

refundedAmount.description: INR refunded so far, this refund included.

refundAmount.description: PAYMENT_REFUNDED only: the INR this refund returned.

providerRef.description: Razorpay order id (order_...) or the mock charge id.

status.description: The payment's status after the event. REFUNDED only once refunded in full; a partial refund leaves SUCCEEDED.

reason.description: PAYMENT_FAILED: why (shown to the rider). PAYMENT_REFUNDED: the refund reason.
